data_fields.name: fade_in_per_s
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.002 per step x2 (about 0.2 per second at 50 steps per second)

best_idea: A music state chosen by a fixed priority ladder (boss over combat over shop over level), each state with its own fade speed, switched by a two-track crossfade that also ducks under notifications to a floor.
decision_why: Keep the ladder, the per-state fade speeds, the two-track crossfade and the notification duck, which fit combat and boss music in a browser fight. Change the donor's reset on resume, the cut of a third track, and the per-pass fade clock, all of which are defects. The donor is BSD-2 but calls FMOD, so only the shape is taken.
acceptance: With a fake clock in the browser: entering combat rises the combat track to full in 1.25 s; a notification drops the live music to 0.5 within 0.4 s and restores it within 2.5 s at the level rate; returning to the level track mid-fade resumes it at the same volume with no dip.
